card.name: Sentence end before next section number
card.fires_on: The space or period at the very end of a subsection, right before the next numbered heading such as 2.5, 4.3 or 5.8 in prescribing-information text. Often follows a bracketed cross-reference.

modes.label: After cross-reference
modes.description: Gap after a closing bracket citing a section, just before the next numbered heading.
modes.example: [see Clinical Pharmacology (12.3) ].<< >>2.5 Preparation and Administration of NU

modes.label: After plain sentence
modes.description: Gap or period after the last sentence of a subsection, before the next heading number.
modes.example: known hypersensitivity to the product.<< >>4.3 Monoamine Oxidase

card.plain: It marks the point where one numbered section of a drug label ends and the next heading is about to begin.
